5Write a question for each answer. Use the question word in brackets. Ask about the underlined information.

    (What) Mina invented a water-saving device last year.

6Read the fictional biography chart. Write T (True) or F (False).

YearEvent
1992Mert Aydın was born in Konya.
2003He moved to Bursa.
2010He finished high school and began studying engineering.
2014He graduated from university.
2015He joined a research laboratory.
2018He invented a water filter.
2019He won a science award.
2022He published his first book.
2024He started a scholarship fund.
  1. 1

    Mert Aydın was born in Konya in 1992.

  2. 2

    He moved to Bursa in 2010.

  3. 3

    He finished high school in 2010.

  4. 4

    He graduated from university in 2014.

  5. 5

    He joined a research laboratory in 2014.

  6. 6

    He invented a water filter in 2018.

  7. 7

    He won a science award in 2019.

  8. 8

    He published his first book in 2019.

  9. 9

    He started a scholarship fund in 2024.

  10. 10

    Konya was his birthplace.

  11. 11

    He moved to Bursa before he finished high school.

  12. 12

    He graduated after he joined the laboratory.

  13. 13

    He won the science award before he invented the filter.

  14. 14

    He published his book after he won the award.

  15. 15

    He started the scholarship fund before he published his book.
